name: Control Weather
description:
Concentration, up to 8 hours.

You take control of the weather out to a distance of 5 miles. You may cause conditions that exist anywhere in your world, but the weather changes gradually, with a subtle change taking 10 minutes and a dramatic change taking 1 hour.

You must maintain an unobstructed path between you and the sky while concentrating. Otherwise, the spell ends.

Describe the weather.
